sn36.6:1.25: The ablative _dukkhasmā_ here is explained by the commentary as taking an instrumental sense, like the preceding terms.
sn36.6:4.2: By saying that they “do not feel” the feeling, the verse directly contradicts the main theme of the discourse. The commentary does not notice this verse at all, as it only comments on “learned” after “appraised” in the next verse.
